review.scope: Operator-authorized prediction charter selection linkage; verify exact approval scope, shared campaign prompts, no frozen code mutation or launch grant. User approval recorded at a94d886 packet. Source-only review.
findings: Approval scope enforced exactly and fail-closed: selected_prediction_context requires literal status OPERATOR_RATIFIED_CHARTER_CONDITIONAL_ADOPTION, charter_ratified and conditional_external_seed_adoption exactly True, and patient_launch/new_backend_patient_transfer/reserved_cohort_access exactly False (missing keys reject via 'is not False'); disposition records launch_authorized: false and names the separate preflight/launch gates. Matches the a94d886 decision packet's stated grant.

Identity bindings complete: the selection binds decision packet (commit a94d886e, SHA-256), proposal receipt, all five round-1 artifacts, and frozen P001 SPEC.md/run.py/review.json/investigator_decision.json/build_receipt.json; every bound name is byte-verified via checked() with root-containment and symlink rejection; required.issubset(decision['artifact_sha256']) rejects partial bindings; proposal_context independently re-verifies receipt inputs, mode 'charter', REVIEWED_PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED status, and APPROVE review verdict. Hashes are internally consistent with the adoption document's frozen-identity table.

No frozen code mutation or launch surface: context readers are pure; execute() writes only under campaigns/isles24-pilot/pipeline with symlink-ancestor checks, resolved containment, and mkdir(exist_ok=False); failures persist blocked.json without fabricating receipts; receipts only issue on opposing-family (codex author / claude reviewer) APPROVE with exit-class and CI-provenance checks.

Shared campaign prompts correctly scoped: with a selection present, grounding removes legacy charter/SCORING_RUBRIC/scout prompt and substitutes the ratified hash-bound proposal texts (including PROMPTS.proposed.md), all recorded in each stage receipt's input_sha256; the legacy scout/ideas path is unaffected.

Suggestion: when --proposal-context preview runs alongside an active selection, context.update overwrites context-disposition.json with the preview-only ratified:false disposition, masking the operator-selected status; error direction is conservative (under-claims authority) but distinct keys or a merge would avoid author confusion.

Suggestion: absence of prediction_selection.json silently reverts grounding to legacy charter/rubric/prompt with no marker; no authority is gained, but an accidental post-ratification deletion would be invisible to the pipeline — consider an explicit 'no selection' disposition entry.

Suggestion: the charter/adoption/readiness prompt still states the legacy prompt/rubric 'needs explicit prediction-scoped treatment', which is stale once the selection has replaced them; risks re-proposing solved work.

Minor hardening: proposal_context reads receipt.json twice without binding the second read to the first (acceptable under the documented single-writer assumption), and checked()'s 'if expected and ...' skips verification for empty-string hash values; current producers always emit real hashes.

Source-only review: tests were not executed; the supplied tests cover binding-tamper rejection, path traversal rejection, pending-evidence non-leakage, and the ratified-but-not-launch-authorized disposition.
